Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it.

notes: not automated (save): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
activation: 10 minute is not an action-economy cost
concentration: nothing it sustains was converted
"Create Sensor" is passive or triggered: not automated
